title: FloodGuard Private Flood Policy — Tier Eligibility Schedule
content:
The FloodGuard Private Flood Policy is written in six tiers, ranked from 1 to 6: FloodGuard Contents Only, FloodGuard Essential, FloodGuard Standard, FloodGuard Plus, FloodGuard Premier and FloodGuard High Value. Each tier carries its own entry conditions for the insured building and states whether building property can be insured at all.

## Schedule of entry conditions

| Rank | Tier | Building in Ohio | Flood claims in the last 10 years, at most | Flood zones accepted | Building property insurable |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | FloodGuard Contents Only | Required | 1 | X, A, AE | No — contents only |
| 2 | FloodGuard Essential | Required | 1 | X, A, AE | Yes |
| 3 | FloodGuard Standard | Required | 1 | X, A, AE | Yes |
| 4 | FloodGuard Plus | Required | 1 | X, A, AE, VE | Yes |
| 5 | FloodGuard Premier | Required | 0 | X, A, AE, VE | Yes |
| 6 | FloodGuard High Value | Required | 0 | X, A, AE, VE | Yes |

## Reading the schedule

1. **Location.** Every tier requires the insured building to be in Ohio.
2. **Flood claim history.** The count is of flood claims in the last 10 years. FloodGuard Contents Only, Essential, Standard and Plus accept at most one; FloodGuard Premier and High Value accept none.
3. **Flood zone.** Zone VE is accepted only on FloodGuard Plus, Premier and High Value. Zones X, A and AE are accepted on every tier.
4. **Building property.** FloodGuard Contents Only insures contents only; building property can be insured on every other tier.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical buildings)

- *A hypothetical Ohio building in zone VE with no flood claims in the last 10 years* meets the entry conditions of FloodGuard Plus, Premier and High Value, and of no lower tier, because zone VE is not among the zones the first three tiers accept.
- *A hypothetical Ohio building in zone AE with one flood claim in the last 10 years* meets the entry conditions of FloodGuard Contents Only, Essential, Standard and Plus; FloodGuard Premier and High Value accept no flood claim in that period.
- *A hypothetical Ohio building in zone X with two flood claims in the last 10 years* meets the entry conditions of no tier, since the highest count any tier accepts is one.
